The parents of a girl who went missing in Ejigbo, Lagos State, two years ago are appealing for help to find their daughter, who was five at the time of her disappearance. They believe she was abducted while she was with her brother at their Arabic school. They said CCTV footage captured the suspected abductor with both children before the boy was later abandoned at a mall, while their daughter was taken away. NCC targets fake, cloned phones with device checker FG begins review of 2019 security strategy amid emerging threats Court remands actress Doris Ogala for cyberstalking Lagos pastor Since her disappearance, the parents say they have tried various means, including working with the police and pursuing other leads, but have yet to find her. Having spent their resources searching for her, they are now seeking assistance to continue the search, insisting they believe their daughter is still alive and hoping to bring her home.
